verdict: Paid leads stopped this week; Meta is being restored now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 77 leads at $8.31 per lead — all from Meta. Starting September 12, Meta went to zero spend for 6 consecutive days, which cut off your only active paid source and brought new leads to a complete stop this past week. This was a channel interruption, not a creative or audience problem — prior performance was solid before the spend went dark. Restoring Meta spend is the immediate priority, with the top campaign back in focus first. Once spend is live again, lead volume should recover in line with the $8.31 cost per lead you were running before the disruption.

consecutive days Meta ran at zero spend, wiping all new leads this past week

watch_item.issue: 74 CRM opportunities created this period with zero converted — leads are entering the pipeline but not moving through intake.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the intake and follow-up process alongside the ad restoration so that leads arriving once spend resumes have a clearer path to becoming patients.
